map.CPC 和 CPM 怎么选？: How do I choose between CPC and CPM?
map.CTR 低通常是素材或定向问题，先优化创意和人群，再调出价，否则高 CPM 也换: A low CTR is usually a creative or targeting problem. Optimize the creative and the audience first, then adjust the bid; otherwise a high CPM will not buy you effective clicks.
map.CTR 太低说明什么？: What does a low CTR mean?
map.代理用 CPM 采买时换算成 CPC 看单价是否超标。: When buying through an agency at CPM, convert it to CPC to check whether the unit price is over the limit.
map.在CPC、CPM、CPA等多种广告计费模式间换算，输入预算或展示、点击数据，估算: Convert between CPC, CPM, CPA and other advertising billing models. Enter a budget or impression/click data to estimate unit cost and campaign effect, helping optimize campaign delivery.
map.已知日预算和出价，反推能买多少点击、多少展示。: Given a daily budget and a bid, back-solve how many clicks and impressions you can buy.
map.设定目标转化数与预估 CPA，倒推需要多少预算。: Set the target conversions and the estimated CPA to work backwards to the budget needed.
map.追求点击/转化选 CPC，按效果付费更稳；做品牌曝光选 CPM，按展示量买量更便: Choose CPC when you want clicks or conversions, since paying per effect is steadier; choose CPM for brand exposure, where buying impressions is cheaper.
map.：预算 5000、CPC 2 元 → 点击 2500；CTR 2% → 展示 2: : budget 5000, CPC 2 CNY -> 2500 clicks; CTR 2% -> impressions 2500/0.02=125000; CPM=5000/(125000/1000)=40 CNY; 100 target conversions -> CPA=50 CNY.
map.：预算 5000、CPM 40 元 → 展示 125000；CTR 2% → 点: : budget 5000, CPM 40 CNY -> 125000 impressions; CTR 2% -> 2500 clicks, CPC=5000/2500=2 CNY; 100 conversions -> CPA=50 CNY. The unit price is identical under both buying models.
